test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.**

Electrolytes like

P. important for balancing the water in your body

Q. are present in the body’s fluids and are

R. are electrically charged minerals that

S. sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium
solution:
The correct answer is: SRQP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Here, the first part of the whole sentence is already given.
 
• After that 'S' should be the best fit to keep the sentence meaningful. The first word of the 'S' part is "sodium". So, if we connect it with the first one, the sentence will be like "Electrolytes like sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium."
 
• Then 'R' follows 'S' to keep the sentence meaningful. The sentence will be like "...sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium are electrically charged minerals" which means "Minerals with electrical charges include sodium, potassium, chloride, and magnesium."
 
• After that 'Q' follows '**R**' and connecting the parts will be like "...minerals that are present in the body’s fluids.."
 
• Lastly 'P' should be placed as it is the closing statement as it is defining the importance of all these minerals.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4, i.e. SRQP.

 

**Let us look at the whole sentence after rearranging it:** *Electrolytes like sodium, potassium, chloride and magnesium are electrically charged minerals that are present in the body’s fluids and are important for balancing the water in your body.*
